name: dsh_workflow
description: Brings Claude Code's UltraCode mode to DSH: upgrade one-shot multi-agent dispatch into a generatable, saveable, governable, observable, recoverable workflow layer.
description_zh: 把 Claude Code 的 UltraCode 模式带给 DSH：将一次性多 Agent 调度升级为可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。
_source_description: 把Claude Code的UltraCode模式带给DSH，把 DSH 的一次性多 Agent 调度，升级为可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层

name: mstar-harness
description: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent: tune agent loops as a first-class workflow.
description_zh: 技能驱动的 Harness/Loop 工程工作流 Agent：把 Agent 循环调优作为一等工作流。
_source_description: A Skill-driven Harness/Loop Engineering Workflow Agent Plugin

name: dsh-automation
description: Run coding tasks on a schedule in fresh Agent sessions, managed by the user or the agent itself.
description_zh: 让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，由用户或 Agent 创建和管理定时任务。
_source_description: DSH 自动化插件：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，并由用户或 Agent 创建和管理定时任务。 / Run coding tasks in fresh Agent sessions and manage schedules from DSH Web or an Agent.

name: dsh-auto-continue
description: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: failure classification, adaptive retry, configurable continue message and browser notifications.
description_zh: 自动恢复中断的请求：失败分类、自适应退避重试、可配置续写消息与浏览器通知。
_source_description: DSH Web UI plugin: auto-sends 「继续」 to resume requests interrupted by network errors or other non-human causes — error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text, browser notifications, all configurable from the settings card

name: dsh-deep-research
description: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator built on the official workflow engine.
description_zh: 基于官方 workflow 引擎的自适应深度研究编排器。
_source_description: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator plugin for DeepSeek Harness (official workflow engine, cybernetics/information-theory design)

name: dsh-plans
description: Human-in-the-loop planning preset adapted from prime-plans: researched, reviewed, executed.
description_zh: 从 prime-plans 移植的人机协同规划预设：调研、评审、执行。
_source_description: Human-in-the-loop planning preset for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), adapted from prime-plans: researched Markdown plans in ./dsh-plans, reviewer/criticizer subagent refinement, per-workspace language & model settings, goal-driven execution with ponytail + MVP tests.

name: dsh-harness-ops
description: Ops toolbox: A/B dual-slot daily snapshot rotation with atomic switch and one-click rollback, plus a 10s watchdog.
description_zh: 运维工具箱：官方每日快照 A/B 双槽轮换、原子切换、一键回滚、守护进程自动拉起。
_source_description: DSH 运维工具箱：升级、重启、故障都不用操心。① 官方每日快照 A/B 双槽轮换——旧插件迁移+构建+验收全过才原子切换，一键回滚，旧版本永远兜底；② 守护 10s 自动拉起 web + agent 断点自动续接，重启无人值守；③ web 全挂（A/B 都坏、agent 不可用）时 dsh-doctor 一条命令自救：九项诊断→机械修复配置→LLM 深度检测修复（完整推理实时可见）→拉起 web。install via: git clone + bash scripts/install.sh

name: engineer-software
description: Runtime-neutral, evidence-driven software engineering workflow for Codex and DeepSeek Harness.
description_zh: 与运行时无关、证据驱动的软件工程工作流，适用于 Codex 与 DeepSeek Harness。
_source_description: A runtime-neutral, evidence-driven software engineering workflow for Codex and DeepSeek Harness.

name: dsh-track
description: Embedded task-management engine: decision-point protocol, thought-capture wall and Linear-style issue storage.
description_zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎：决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储。
_source_description: DSH Track Bridge 插件：嵌入式任务管理引擎——决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储（bundle），AI 与人之间的任务轨道

name: dsh-inspect
description: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop built on the official workflow engine.
description_zh: 发现问题(checkup) → 修复交付(fix) → 质量复查(review) 的对抗式闭环。
_source_description: 发现问题(checkup) → 修复交付(fix) → 质量复查(review) 的对抗式闭环插件：基于官方 workflow 引擎的检查/修复/复查工具集

name: dsh-companion
description: Resident desktop assistant: global hotkey, scheduled automation, quick replies and a plugin market.
description_zh: 常驻桌面助手：全局唤起、定时自动化、快捷回复、插件市场。
_source_description: DeepSeek Harness 的常驻桌面助手：全局唤起、定时自动化、快捷回复、插件市场

name: dsh-deepresearch
description: DeepResearch plugin (cordis) for the Harness.
description_zh: 面向 Harness 的 DeepResearch 插件（cordis）。

name: dsh-prime-agent
description: Prime Agent-inspired persistent RLM control plane for DSH Code Mode.
description_zh: Prime Agent 启发的持久 RLM 控制平面，面向 DSH Code 模式。
_source_description: Prime Agent-inspired persistent RLM control plane for DeepSeek Harness Code Mode

name: dsh-plugin-spur
description: Hang a whip in the chat stream: flick it (>2.0 px/ms) to send the agent a 'go work' message.
description_zh: 聊天流中悬挂皮鞭：甩动鞭梢即向 agent 发送 go work 消息（整活）。
_source_description: 聊天流中悬挂皮鞭，甩动鞭梢（>2.0 px/ms）即向 agent 发送 go work 消息 | A whip hanging in the chat stream; flick the tip (>2.0 px/ms) to send the agent a "go work!" message

name: dsh-agent-orchestration
description: Evidence-first multi-agent workflow planning, handoff validation, and Loop Guard skills for DeepSeek Harness.
description_zh: Evidence-first multi-agent workflow planning, handoff validation, and Loop Guard skills for DeepSeek Harness.
_source_description: Evidence-first multi-agent workflow planning, handoff validation, and Loop Guard skills for DeepSeek Harness.

name: dsh-doublecheck
description: Engineering-discipline loop: requirement grilling before edits, red/green test-evidence gates and adversarial delivery review.
description_zh: 工程纪律循环：编辑前需求拷问、红/绿测试证据门、对抗式交付审查。
_source_description: Double-check before you ship: grill the requirements, test the implementation, prove the delivery. An engineering-discipline bundle for DeepSeek Harness.

name: dsh-governance
description: Authority layer for agentic AI as a DSH plugin: governs every tool call against your policies.
description_zh: Agentic AI 的权威层插件：按你的策略治理每次工具调用。
_source_description: The authority layer for agentic AI, as a DeepSeek Harness plugin. Governs every tool call against your business rules via TapPass /v1/govern.

name: dsh-task-dag
description: Persistent live DAG visualization of workflow runs, subagents, status and dependencies.
description_zh: 工作流运行、子代理、状态与依赖的持久化实时 DAG 可视化。
_source_description: Persistent live DAG visualization for DeepSeek Harness subagents and workflows

name: dsh-report-studio
description: Turn a DSH session into deliverable work reports (daily/weekly/handoff/article) with verifiable receipts.
description_zh: 把 DSH 会话变成可交付工作报告（日报/周报/交接/文章），带可验证凭证。
_source_description: Turn a DeepSeek Harness session into deliverable work reports (daily/weekly/handoff/article) with verifiable receipts

name: dsh-eval
description: Agent evaluation platform: benchmark YAML, headless dsh runs, trace-based metrics, scripted grading and run comparison.
description_zh: Agent 评测平台：benchmark YAML、无头 dsh 运行、基于 trace 的指标、脚本评分与运行对比。
_source_description: Agent evaluation platform for DeepSeek Harness: benchmark YAML, headless dsh orchestration, trace-based metrics, LLM judge, paired A/B, keyless replay, and cross-harness import.

name: dsh-trajectory-debug
description: Trajectory waterfall, deterministic replay, breakpoints, edit-and-rerun, fork compare and performance analytics.
description_zh: 轨迹瀑布流、确定性回放、断点、编辑重跑、fork 对比与性能分析。
